join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !repeat on <name>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !repeat off <name>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat on repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat off repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' does not exist.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme Hello there!
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat on repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' has no repeat.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat off repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' has no repeat.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' will now repeat every 600 seconds if at least 1 message has passed.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat on repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Repeated command 'repeatme' is already enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat off repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Repeated command 'repeatme' is now disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat off repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Repeated command 'repeatme' is already disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat on repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Repeated command 'repeatme' is now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command addb repeatme2 Hello there!
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme2' added, restricted to broadcasters and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme2 600
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme2' will now repeat every 600 seconds if at least 1 message has passed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 modman/2 access=moderator :!repeat on repeatme2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme2' is restricted to broadcasters; only broadcasters and above can modify its repeat.

handle hortbot foobar/1 modman/2 access=moderator :!repeat off repeatme2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme2' is restricted to broadcasters; only broadcasters and above can modify its repeat.
